result.summary: The page layout and rendering appear largely intact, but one visible content defect remains: an untranslated localization key is shown as a section heading.

issues.description: An untranslated localization key, "home_feed.popular_title", is displayed as the section heading instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the raw key with the proper localized string (e.g., "Popular near you") and verify that the translation lookup for this key is configured.
